model.architecture: Microsoft's 4.7B vision-language model: a 24-layer ViT with 3-D rotary position embeddings feeds a Qwen3-4B language decoder.

variants.quantization: Decoder Qwen3-4B int4 weights (symmetric, blockwise-128 + OCTAV); int8 externalized embedder; vision ViT int8 weights; adapter int8

recommended.reason: the Android path verified on a Galaxy S26 (S4 gate 2026-08-25): full delegation (6618 ops across 4 subgraphs) and a correct answer to the probe; 17.1 tok/s decode, engine init 6.5 s, peak 820 MB. No same-device CPU control was taken, so this is the verified choice for the class, not a measured win over CPU

platform_notes: Context (KV cache) 2048 (vs the trained 262k) — chosen so the fp32 KV cache stays ~0.6 GB and the whole session stays under ~1.5 GiB on the phone.
Image input resized to 448x448 (OpenAI-CLIP normalization baked into the encoder); 196 image tokens.
Text-only follow-up turns in the same conversation have ~2 s time-to-first-token on the phone.
No positional compromise: the decoder natively uses plain sequential 1-D positions (no M-RoPE), exactly what fast_vlm supplies; the Qwen2-VL 2-D-table-ranking caveat does not apply.
Mobile-GPU-safe graph: no GATHER_ND; the 2x2 merge is 4 strided slices + concat, all ops <=4D; vision tower has zero FLEX/CUSTOM ops.
Galaxy S26 GPU gate covers engine creation and the text path only (no image in the gate prompt); the vision path on the GPU is not measured there. XNNPACK takes 1 of 4 nodes in main.

Verified platforms are iPhone, macOS and (engine bring-up + text path on GPU, via the CLI, not the Gallery app) a Galaxy S26; Gallery import follows the same bundle contract as the other fast_vlm models.
The 2026-08-29 default-system-prompt restore adds 11 prefill tokens to a conversation that sends no system message, so time-to-first-token grows by that much; per-token speed is unchanged.
Card claims the same file runs on macOS, Linux and Windows (Linux/Windows not measured on the card).
Not a measured row: card reports iPhone 17 Pro cpu decode_tps 10, ttft_s 7.5-9 (card: Performance table iPhone row + 'Performance (measured)' table; runtime/run count not stated)

S4 GPU gate, 205-token benchmark, single run; full delegation (6618 ops across 4 subgraphs); generation gate answered the probe correctly. No same-device CPU control was taken, so this is a GPU speed, not a measured win over CPU.

known_issues: Image-only bundle: the base model's video pipeline is not included; send each image in its own message — multiple images in one conversation are untested.
Swift runtime: bring the engine up with the vision modality only — requesting .all fails at session creation on bundles without an audio section.
Desktop 8-question text sanity gate 7/8 with no degeneration; vision tower corr 0.994 at int8 vs the reference.

2026-08-28/29/30/31 metadata- and tokenizer-only changes (weights unchanged): accuracy figures and on-device rows were measured on the previous file; the on-device gate has not been re-run. Re-download if downloaded before 2026-08-30.

Before 2026-08-30 the bundled SentencePiece tokenizer mis-encoded standalone accented letters/symbols and mapped emoji and most Latin Extended-A to the end-of-text token; now replaced by the upstream tokenizer.json.
Before 2026-08-31 the chat template matched history turns only on role 'model', so Conversation-API history with role 'assistant' was silently dropped; fixed (LiteRT-LM#3417).
